gloss_en: The 'spirit of God' (ruach Elokim) — the divine spirit that hovered over the waters (Genesis 1:2) and filled Bezalel with wisdom (Exodus 31:3); in Likutey Moharan the God-given prophetic/inspired spirit identified with the spirit of Mashiach, the comprehensive spirit (ruach ha-kollel) of the true leader (Moshe), and the mochin — not 'wind' in the meteorological sense, nor a human spirit as such
